tools.name: placepack_list_presets
tools.description: Return named PlacePack size presets with labels, specs, and default formats.

tools.name: placepack_create_image
tools.description: Validate one size spec and return an embeddable PlacePack image URL, filename, Markdown, and HTML.

spec.description: Size spec such as 800x600.svg, hero:1600x900, or thumb:420x247@2x.

bgColor.description: Background hex color, with or without #.

textColor.description: Label hex color, with or without #.

tools.name: placepack_create_pack
tools.description: Validate multiple size specs or one preset and return a manifest of generated PlacePack image URLs. Optionally inline a small SVG ZIP as base64.

preset.description: Preset key such as og, developers, automation, or favicon.

bgColor.description: Background hex color, with or without #.

textColor.description: Label hex color, with or without #.

inlineZip.description: Return a base64 ZIP for SVG packs with at most 10 files.
